spec.upstream: the E204 exposure sweep + its declared reader baseline (this module)
spec.question: E204 answered who reads a silent delta face today. The cheaper question is what happens tomorrow: the first external reader is the moment prose hygiene becomes a trap.
spec.crossing_rule: baseline reader in ['producer_only', 'no_reader_in_repo', 'read_by_a_round_scratch_script'] AND now read_outside_the_producer AND the face still needs a sign line
spec.born_rule: a face absent from the baseline that is already a trap
spec.retire_rule: a baseline face that no longer exists is reported, never failed
spec.exit: 0 clean / 0 after seeding / 3 a crossing was found

honest: the baseline is a ratchet, not a verdict: seeding it blesses today's map, including any face that is already read externally -- re-seed only on purpose
growth is detected between two runs of this leg, so a reader added and removed between two runs is invisible to it
the reader scan is in-repo only (same limit as E204): prose, figures files and out-of-repo consumers are not visible
law_ref: O-20260924-1626 R3 (advisory-to-blocking: the crossing costs a whole sign)
